meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: Claude 仍是主控,但可以把任务交给本机 Ollama 模型:默认提供「列出已安装模型」和「用指定模型生成回答」两个工具;在 .env 里设 OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS=true 后,还会多出下载、删除、查看模型和查看已加载模型四类工具。
howto.when: 当你要求用本机 Ollama 模型来回答(例如「use ollama to tell me...」),或者要它列出、下载、删除本地模型时接管。

say.text: 列出本机已安装的 ollama 模型

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload work to local Ollama models. By default it gets tools to list installed models and generate responses; with OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS=true it also gets pull, delete, show and list-running tools.
howto.when_en: When you ask it to answer with a local Ollama model (e.g. "use ollama to tell me..."), or to list, pull or delete local models.

say_en.text: use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models first, then uses ollama_generate

say_en.text: list the ollama models installed on this machine
